illustration.description: Full-page woodcut portrait of St. Mark the Evangelist (ቅዱስ ማርቆስ) seated on a lion-carved chair at a round writing table with an open Gospel codex and inkstand. A pillar topped with a small winged figure stands to the right, and the Holy Spirit descends as a dove in the upper right corner beneath a ribbon inscribed 'ቅ ፡ ማርቆስ ።', all enclosed within an ornate traditional Ethiopian Harag (ሐረግ) interlace border.
